0e7417e5f8.q: What accuracy challenges does AI pose when generating product visuals for technical and complex manufacturing products?
0e7417e5f8.a: AI will take liberties and make things up when producing visuals, which is particularly problematic for manufacturing products where accuracy is critical. Engineers work with precision measurements like thousandths of a hair width, so having visually accurate representations is essential. While AI-generated images may look like the product, they may not actually be the customer's specific product, creating credibility issues.
